profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Roku Inc.
profile.summary:
I am a full-stack software engineer, with recently focusing on big data engineer and infrastructure. Over my career, I worked in a board spectrum of technologies and delivered many successful projects. My recent achievement is building a Machine Learning platform to help data scientists to develop models and operate them in production.

I am fast learner, adaptive, result-oriented, and I always strive for a better solution.

positions.title: Senior Data Engineer
positions.description: I worked in AI Speech team and responsible for many key pipelines & dashboards for data collections & annotations.

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description:
Led the development of Arimo BAI Platform, an internal ML platform:
- Designed and implemented model management and metric tracking API to allow the data scientists to store and retrieve models from the platform, and keep track of metrics over time
- Designed and implemented workflow engine to allow data scientists to compose model ETL/training/scoring workflows from Python/R scripts. Integrated with AWS EMR to allow scheduling ETL workload on transient Spark clusters
- Designed and implemented an autoscaling solution to automatically scale the cluster size based on requested GPU requirements from workflow
- Designed and implemented real-time model serving solutions for cloud and edge devices
- Implemented automation tools for AWS, Kubernetes and on-prem deployments. Enforced end-to-end encryption to secure model and data.
- Responsible for customer integration and deployment

Led the data engineering and deployment effort for Arimo Predictive Maintenance solutions
- Designed and implemented data infrastructure to ingest and store daily data from 50k+ IoT appliances
- Designed and implemented Spark pipelines for data aggregation and consolidation. Optimized Spark pipelines for best performance
- Enabled AWS Athena integration to allow data scientists to explore the data
- Automated model training and scoring workflows
Responsible for managing and budgeting cloud infrastructure for the projects

Technologies: Python, Golang, Spark, Hadoop/Yarn, AWS EMR, Parquet/PyArrow, Keras, Scikit-Learn, Tensorflow, TFServing, Celery, Rabbitmq, Postgres, Ansible, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, Prometheus, Keycloak, Jenkins.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led the front-end development of Arimo Analytics Suite
- Managed front-end team assignment and workload
- Worked closely with the product team to define technical requirements and sprint planning
- Performed code review and setup CI/CD pipelines for testing, packaging, and containerization
- Integrated with backend to allow users to query data using natural language, and explore data from the UI
- Integrated with ShareJS to allow users to collaborate in real-time
- Designed and implemented a visualization framework to semi-automatically generate visualization using data schema and distribution
- Optimized frontend to display hundreds of graphs in browsers

Built a chrome extension prototype to extract data from existing D3 charts from the web, and allow users to manipulate, revisualize, and then share the result. The idea was presented in Strata 2016 (http://bit.ly/2E8TXUj)

Built a Sales forecast web app to allow users to explore the sale historical data, see the prediction for the future, and aggregate sales reports across stores and regions.

Technologies: React.js, Meteor, Javascript/Node.js, Share.js, D3.js, Mocha, Python, Golang, Ansible, Terraform, Docker, Jenkins

positions.title: Technical Director / Co-Founder
positions.description:
Led and Managed the engineering team
- Managed team headcount and recruitments
- Managed team workload planning and assignments
- Responsible for project proposal, budgeting, and planning
- Set up and managed company IT infrastructure (hosting, internal tools, ...)
- Set up and managed company software delivery pipelines

Delivered multiple projects successfully to customers, notably
- ViSpot: a Wifi marketing solution to allow the customer to display advertise when user connect to Wifi
- mCMS: a platform to manage content for Android & iOS applications
- BenThanh Online Karaoke solution: a Samsung TV app for user to sing karaoke on the TV
- MyMontebenefits.com: an employee portal for Montefiore Medical Center

Technologies: Nodejs, React, Javascript, PHP, Python, Golang, Java (Android), Objective-C, Drupal, Ansible, Docker, Jenkins, SAML

positions.title: Full-stack Software Engineer / Head of Software Engineering
positions.description:
Led the backend development of SalesPad, an iPad application for marketing and sale of a famous German car manufacturer:
- Implemented administration tools to manage the sale content
- Implemented REST API for iPad application for querying content
- Design and Implemented media synchronization to allow iPad to download the content for offline usage incrementally

Defined and implemented software development workflow for the team
- Set up ticket system and source control system
- Automated testing and delivery pipelines
- Performed code review with the team

Delivered multiple projects successfully to customers, notably:
- a web app to visualize customer activities and relationship
- an Android app for airplane navigation
- an iOS app for showroom production demonstration 

Technologies: Nodejs, Javascript, PHP, Python, Java, Objective-C, Drupal, Jenkins, Redmine, Selenium, Ansible

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented a multi-site CMS for Natixis AM / Ostrum AM
- Designed and implemented an internal system for Employee performance
- Implemented application to generated PDF reports for employee performance
review
- Supported sysadmin team to deploy and integrate projects in customer
environments

Technologies: PHP, C#, Python, Javascript, Drupal, Symfony, NUnit, ASP.NET
MVC, Jenkins, Ansible
